title: Efficiency Frontier for Causal Copula Contrasts under Endpoint-Selective Outcome Observation
banked_reason: Independent main validity gate confirms below-field novelty after three versions and two root reframes; exact identities and witnesses checked, but strict published-frontier separation unverified and adaptive attainment/uniform inference unproved.
gap_reasons: tier=letter below novelty_target=field: under a uniformly positive complete-pair probability, the headline is a model-specific efficient-influence-function/resolvent constant comparison, with no demonstrated new rate regime, strict published bound improvement, or independently established first frontier for a genuinely new estimand.
A strict published-frontier separation required for field escalation is not certified.
No statement proves a strict tightening of a sourced published bound or a field-level regime separation.
proof_attempt_summary: Three proposal versions explored selective-CAR causal copula efficiency, a retention-indexed information frontier, and budget-optimal endpoint retention; exact algebraic checks and legal allocation witnesses supplied partial evidence. Both completed reviews rated letter tier, and the final producer returned needs-pivot because field-level published-frontier separation was unverified. Uniform pilot/entropy/numerical control, whole-surface Gaussian and multiplier inference, adaptive oracle attainment, and remaining source comparisons are unproved; D0 and all Lean formalization stages were never entered, and no Lean certification or impossibility result is claimed.
tldr: The same-unit causal copula contrast \(\Delta C\) measures policy effects on dependence after each outcome is converted to its intervention-specific rank. Known endpoint-specific retention probabilities index an information frontier from count-retaining deletion of singleton values to the original outcome-selective record. The theorem derives its canonical covariance, an exact resolvent path, a necessary-and-sufficient gain criterion, and sharp retention-dependent observable bounds with a legal attaining upper witness. One data-only construction must learn this frontier, attain its covariance in every induced experiment, and deliver full-class simultaneous bands and matching interior-center finite-vector quadratic risk. Generic CAR inversion and copula differentiation are credited foundations. Uniform learned-score calibration and finite near-zero-mass numerical transfer remain open. The scope is a specialist subfield or letter contribution, without a field-novelty claim.
gap: Generic CAR inversion and complete-record policy copula inference do not provide an attainable endpoint-retention information frontier or primitive-uniform finite calibration for selectively observed causal ranks.
fill: Exact same-law operator and resolvent identities certify the retention frontier and sharp factors. A shared complete-pair pilot and a componentwise observable one-step construction must attain the frontier with simultaneous rank inference and induced-experiment lower bounds.
